author: Krono I
title: Ultimate Synergy: Wide+Bottleneck+Dilated CNN (No FE)
abstract: This is my definitive synergy experiment within the new non-feature-engineered (No FE) paradigm. It combines the three most successful architectural innovations: a wide CNN backbone, my SOTA Bottleneck blocks, and dilated convolutions (d=5), all on the raw 8-channel observation. The hypothesis is that this combination will be the most powerful yet and will achieve a new station-wide SOTA, surpassing 77.0.
